profile.headline: Sr. Frontend Software Engineer | Global Web at Williams-Sonoma, Inc.
profile.summary:
As a Engineer working in San Francisco I have had the opportunity to work on various projects from working with small businesses to building enterprise scale SaaS products. 

Much of my work consists of frontend web development with a background in graphic design and traditional design methods. I have a passion for strong brand design and building engaging web content that really captures its audience. 

I love to create smart design systems that are beautifully engaging. Currently I am working as a Frontend Developer on the Global team at Williams Sonoma Inc., helping to create a better shopping experience for our users!

positions.title: Sr. Frontend Software Engineer | Global Web
positions.description: As a Sr. Frontend Software Engineer at Williams-Sonoma, I play a pivotal role in leading a team of engineers to optimize global market sites for WSI brands. By facilitating effective communication between site managers and stakeholders, I ensure the seamless operation of online platforms, driving revenue growth and enhancing user experience.

positions.title: Frontend Software Engineer | Global Web
positions.description: Helping to build the front end experience for the global WSI brands.

positions.title: Designer | Global Web
positions.description: Working on the Global team as the main Web Designer for the Australia site. Currently working on a redesign and replatform of the entire site. Of which, I have worked to both design and develop various associated content pages across the site. Furthermore, my duties include helping with day-to-day design collateral including email design and daily homepage design and deployments, along with various other seasonal site updates. Recently finished complete template redesign of all of the page components into Bootstrap framework to be used by all global sites across the corporate WSI umbrella.

positions.title: Founder
positions.description: Design websites, identity packages, branding elements, advertising, and print collateral. Projects include retail, restaurants, music, action sports and corporate portfolios. Use a holistic approach to create cohesive, strategic elements and campaigns that stay true to the brand voice. Incorporate new technologies and design trends in projects where appropriate.

positions.title: Lead Web Designer
positions.description:
Worked on a global marketing team, helping to design, prototype, and build web parts with personality.

While working at The Myers-Briggs Company I was the lead web designer responsible for their marketing web properties. While there, I had the opportunity to lead a multitude of highly visible and challenging projects, including the successful redesign of the company website and the company rebrand in 2018. I was responsible for developing the user journey, UX flows, wireframes, designs, and web module functionality, and then worked collaboratively with IT in the build out and code deployment. I defined the global web style guide and ensured the established guidelines were extended consistently across all of our global web sites. 

In addition to my work on the global corporate website I was also tasked with building a multitude of microsites including the annual conference website. Lastly, I supported marketing campaign efforts, designing and building campaign landing pages and a modular email marketing template within the marketing automation system, Marketo.

positions.title: Community Manager
positions.description: Responsible for all branded content creation, media, in house and PR. In charge of all social media outlets. Web designer & IT guru. Also helped with large event planning and management.

positions.title: Asst. Manager / Designer
positions.description:
-Designed seasonal marketing collateral including menus, in-store posters, and online elements
-Developed concept and consulted on identity for restaurant expansion into second brand
-Developed signage, menus and collateral for new brand
-Shift manager responsible for a 6-8 person team

positions.title: Corporate Design Intern
positions.description:
-Developed templates for marketing and sales department for property expansion, tailored by industry
-Developed custom presentations for clients using both Ace and client identity elements
-Used company style guide to deliver collateral true to Ace brand

certifications.title: SVG Graphics for the Web with Illustrator

certifications.name: Interactive Animations with CSS and JavaScript
certifications.title: Interactive Animations with CSS and JavaScript

volunteerExperiences.description: Spent time periodically working with an afterschool program at the Clairemont Mesa Boys & Girls Club during my time at San Diego State. It included tutoring, counseling, and general physical education with the children. My mission was to instill good values and ethics in kids who may not experience it at home. All while showing the importance of efficient time-management and a proper live-work balance.
